title: God Is Near
question: Where do you feel brokenhearted today?
prayer: Lord, remind me of Your nearness.

title: Fresh Mercy
question: "What do you need mercy for today?"
prayer: God, let me start fresh with You.

title: Known By Name
question: Where do you feel unseen?
prayer: Jesus, help me rest in being known by You.

title: Cast Your Anxiety
question: What worry do you need to give God?
prayer: Lord, I cast my cares onto You.

title: Strength in Weakness
question: Where do you feel weak?
prayer: Jesus, show Your strength in my weakness.

title: Walk in Light
question: Where do you need clarity?
prayer: Lord, be my light today.

title: A Present Help
question: Where do you need God’s help right now?
prayer: God, be present in my trouble.

title: The Lord My Shepherd
question: Where do you need guidance?
prayer: Shepherd, lead me today.

title: Peace Be Still
question: What storm is inside you today?
prayer: Jesus, speak peace over my heart.

title: God Who Sees
question: Where do you feel misunderstood?
prayer: God who sees me, let me feel seen.

title: Everlasting Arms
question: What burden feels heavy?
prayer: Lord, carry what I cannot.

title: My Refuge
question: Where do you seek refuge today?
prayer: God, be my shelter and rest.

title: The Way Forward
question: What decision do you need wisdom for?
prayer: Lord, make my path straight.

title: Slow to Anger
question: Where do you need patience?
prayer: God, form gentleness in me.

title: Daily Bread
question: What do you need God to provide?
prayer: Father, give me what I need today.

title: Lifted Up
question: Where do you feel low or discouraged?
prayer: God, lift my spirit today.

title: He Holds You
question: What fear do you need to surrender?
prayer: Lord, strengthen and uphold me.

title: Search My Heart
question: What needs examining in you?
prayer: God, reveal what needs Your touch.

title: Joy Comes
question: Where do you need renewed joy?
prayer: Lord, restore joy to my heart.

title: Guard Your Heart
question: What influence do you need to limit?
prayer: God, protect my heart today.

title: Living Water
question: Where do you feel spiritually dry?
prayer: Jesus, refresh my soul.

title: Hope Anchored
question: What feels uncertain?
prayer: Lord, anchor my hope in You.

title: Teach Me Your Way
question: Where do you need direction?
prayer: God, unite my heart to fear You.

title: Draw Near
question: How can you draw near today?
prayer: Lord, meet me as I come close.

title: Abide in Me
question: What distracts you from abiding?
prayer: Jesus, keep me connected to You.

title: The Lord Is Good
question: Where do you need reassurance of God’s goodness?
prayer: God, let me taste and see Your goodness.

title: Stand Firm
question: Where do you feel spiritually attacked?
prayer: Lord, help me stand strong.

title: Spirit of Power
question: Where do you feel timid or held back?
prayer: Holy Spirit, give me courage and boldness.

title: He Is Faithful
question: Where have you seen God's faithfulness?
prayer: Faithful God, finish what You started in me.

title: New Creation
question: What old patterns do you want God to renew?
prayer: Jesus, make me new today.
